verses.greek: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος ἐκλεκτῇ κυρίᾳ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτῆς, οὓς ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐγνωκότες τὴν ἀλήθειαν,
verses.literal: The elder To the elect lady and to the children of her whom I myself love in truth and not I myself only but also all those already knowing the truth —
verses.dgt: The elder to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I only, but also all who have come to know the truth—

verses.greek: διὰ τὴν ἀλήθειαν τὴν μένουσαν ἐν ἡμῖν, καὶ μεθʼ ἡμῶν ἔσται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·
verses.literal: because of the truth which is abiding in us and with us that will be to the age:
verses.dgt: because of the truth that remains in us and will be with us forever:

verses.greek: ἔσται μεθʼ ἡμῶν χάρις ἔλεος εἰρήνη παρὰ θεοῦ πατρός, καὶ παρὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ πατρός, ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἀγάπῃ.
verses.literal: Will be with us grace mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ the Son of the Father in truth and love.
verses.dgt: grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

verses.greek: Ἐχάρην λίαν ὅτι εὕρηκα ἐκ τῶν τέκνων σου περιπατοῦντας ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καθὼς ἐντολὴν ἐλάβομεν παρὰ τοῦ πατρός.
verses.literal: I rejoiced exceedingly that I have found some of the children of you walking in truth even as commandment we received from the Father.
verses.dgt: I rejoiced greatly because I have found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received commandment from the Father.

verses.greek: καὶ νῦν ἐρωτῶ σε, κυρία, οὐχ ὡς ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφων σοι ἀλλὰ ἣν εἴχομεν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους.
verses.literal: And now I implore you lady not as a commandment new I am writing to you but that which we have had from the beginning that we may love one another.
verses.dgt: And now I ask you, lady—not as though writing you a new commandment, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.

verses.greek: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη, ἵνα περιπατῶμεν κατὰ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ· αὕτη ἡ ἐντολή ἐστιν, καθὼς ἠκούσατε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῇ περιπατῆτε.
verses.literal: And this is the love that we may walk according to the commandments of Him. This the commandment is even as you have heard from the beginning so that in it you may walk
verses.dgt: And this is love: that we walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, just as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

verses.greek: ὅτι πολλοὶ πλάνοι ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸν κόσμον, οἱ μὴ ὁμολογοῦντες Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐρχόμενον ἐν σαρκί· οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πλάνος καὶ ὁ ἀντίχριστος.
verses.literal: For many deceivers have gone out into the world those not confessing Jesus Christ coming in flesh This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
verses.dgt: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.

verses.greek: βλέπετε ἑαυτούς, ἵνα μὴ ἀπολέσητε ἃ εἰργασάμεθα, ἀλλὰ μισθὸν πλήρη ἀπολάβητε.
verses.literal: do watch yourselves so that not you may lose what things we have worked for but a reward full you may receive.
verses.dgt: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but may receive a full reward.

verses.greek: πᾶς ὁ προάγων καὶ μὴ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ θεὸν οὐκ ἔχει· ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ, οὗτος καὶ τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει.
verses.literal: Anyone who is progressing and not abiding in the teaching the of Christ God not has The one abiding in the teaching this one both the Father and the Son has.
verses.dgt: Everyone who goes beyond and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not have God. The one who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

verses.greek: εἴ τις ἔρχεται πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ταύτην τὴν διδαχὴν οὐ φέρει, μὴ λαμβάνετε αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν καὶ χαίρειν αὐτῷ μὴ λέγετε·
verses.literal: If anyone comes to you and this the teaching not does bring not do receive him into the house and to greet him not do tell
verses.dgt: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into the house and do not say a greeting to him,

verses.greek: ὁ λέγων γὰρ αὐτῷ χαίρειν κοινωνεῖ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ τοῖς πονηροῖς.
verses.literal: the one telling for him to rejoice partakes in the works of him the evil.
verses.dgt: for the one who says a greeting to him shares in his evil works.

verses.greek: Πολλὰ ἔχων ὑμῖν γράφειν οὐκ ἐβουλήθην διὰ χάρτου καὶ μέλανος, ἀλλὰ ἐλπίζω γενέσθαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ στόμα πρὸς στόμα λαλῆσαι, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν πεπληρωμένη ᾖ.
verses.literal: Many things having to you to write not I purposed with paper and ink but I hope to come to you and mouth to mouth to speak so that the joy of us completed may be.
verses.dgt: Though I have many things to write to you, I did not want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that your joy may be made complete.

verses.greek: Ἀσπάζεταί σε τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἀδελφῆς σου τῆς ἐκλεκτῆς.
verses.literal: Greet you the children of the sister of you the elect
verses.dgt: The children of your chosen sister greet you.
